messages.text: BL-1802 🎵 in progress — The reset to origin/main moves whatever branch its checkout is on: refuse-reset-if-local-ahead! authorises it from main's ahead count, so in a linked worktree on another branch it resets that branch and discards its unlanded commits (swarmforge-QA lost d861769a5b at 12:05:28Z on 2026-09-29, inside QA's pre-commit property run); the gate now also refuses unless the checkout is on main, refuses a caller that gives it no branch reading, and the property fixture that reached the live QA worktree is found and fixed
